info.name: OF51 - Get offers CSV file

params.name: last_request_date
params.description:
Date and time of your last request.
If provided, retrieves all offers updated since this date and time, including deleted and inactive offers.
If not provided, retrieves all active offers only, unless otherwise specified in the include_inactive_offers field.

params.name: channel_codes
params.description: List of the channel codes to filter with, using a comma (,) as a separator. If specified, only offers that can be sold on the specified channel(s) will be returned. If not, offers will be returned regardless of their channels.

params.name: shipping_zones
params.description: List of the shipping zones codes to filter with, URL-encoded and using a comma (,) as a separator. If specified, only shipping information linked to the given zones will be returned. Otherwise, all shipping information for all zones will be returned.

params.name: include_inactive_offers
params.description:
When calling the API in full mode (i.e. when no last_request_date is provided), inactive offers are not returned. To retrieve both active and inactive offers, set this field to true.
When calling the API in differential mode (i.e. when the last_request_date is provided), both active and inactive offers are returned. This field cannot be used in differential mode otherwise the call fails.

params.name: include_fields
params.description: List of the fields to include, URL-encoded and using a comma (,) as a separator. If specified, only listed fields will be returned.

params.name: models
params.description: A comma separated list of platform models to filter with. Accepted values are MARKETPLACE, DROPSHIP, ONE_CREDITOR

info.name: P11 - List offers for each given product

params.name: product_ids
params.description:
List of product's skus separated with comma. Limited to 100 values.

One of the two is required `product_ids` or `product_references`.

params.name: product_references
params.description:
List of the product's identifiers with type _(structure: "`product_references=|,|, ...`")_.
Limited to 100 values. One of the two is required product_ids or product_references. Example: /api/products/offers?product_references=EAN|3120201243238

params.name: offer_state_codes
params.description: List of offer state codes

params.name: premium
params.description:
If `true`, returns only offers of premium shops.
If `false`, returns only offers of shops that are not premium.

params.name: all_offers
params.description: If false returns only active offers. If true return all offers.

params.name: channel_codes
params.description: List of the channel codes to filter with, using a comma (,) as a separator. If specified, only offers that can be sold on the specified channel(s) will be returned. If not, offers will be returned regardless of their channels.

params.name: all_channels
params.description:
If `false`, filters the offers with the given `channel_codes` or the default channel if no `channel_codes` are given.
If `true`, does not filter the offers on channels and ignore the `channel_codes`.

params.name: pricing_channel_code
params.description: Filter used to pick prices on a specific channel

params.name: pricing_customer_organization_id
params.description: For Customer Pricing users only. Customer identifier code the API will use to return all prices and applicable price for this organization. Ignored if value does not exist.

params.name: shop_ids
params.description:
List of shop IDs separated with comma. Limited to 100 values.

Filter used to return only the offers of the listed shops.

params.name: shipping_zones
params.description: List of shipping zones. Filter used to pick shipping prices on one or multiple shipping zones

params.name: all_shipping_zones
params.description:
If `false`, filters the offers with the given shipping zones.
If `true`, selects all shop shipping zones and ignores the provided `shipping_zones`.

params.name: models
params.description:
A comma separated list of platform models to filter with.
Accepted values are `MARKETPLACE`, `DROPSHIP`, `ONE_CREDITOR`

info.name: PRI01 - Import a price file

items.docs:
Description
Import a .csv file to submit all applicable prices for an offer.
The import mode is delete and replace: any existing price that is not submitted will be deleted.
If Price Approval is enabled, this API creates and updates pending prices; ongoing prices will remain.
Returns an import identifier to track the status of the import and retrieve an error report if applicable.

info.name: PRI03 - Get the error report for a price import in CSV format

params.name: import_id
params.description: Import identifier

items.docs:
Description
Only returns lines of offers with at least one offer price in error.
The first column contains the line number in error. The second column contains the error reason.
The returned file is ready to be reimported after the values have been fixed.
Offer prices that were submitted in the price import but don't appear in the error report were successfully imported.
Call
